verdict.rationale: Deepgram's data docs say requests join the Model Improvement Program by default and are retained, but users can opt out per request with mip_opt_out=true, and opted-out requests are not retained. That lets a user keep their data out of training, but only through a per-request flag on a default-on program, and the evidence doesn't confirm the flag applies to the Voice Agent API specifically. Missing for 10: an account-level or default opt-out, explicit confirmation that mip_opt_out works on the Voice Agent endpoint, coverage of training by the third-party LLM providers in the agent pipeline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
